notes.title: Update 0.2.5.6
notes.content: [h1]Update 0.2.5.6[/h1][p][/p][p]A new [b]update[/b] is available![/p][p][/p][p]Royal Sauterie has grown more complex, and it was necessary to strengthen some existing systems and design choices to prepare for upcoming features.[/p][p][/p][h2]Summary[/h2][list][*][p][b]Royal Sauterie now has a proper UI design system, and all menus have been updated using this new system.[/b] This improves UI consistency and will make future UI development easier.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The programming of in-game characters is now more robust.[/b] These changes aren't visible to players but will improve maintainability and ease the addition of new features.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]Note: The current UI may appear somewhat bare. I'm focusing on functionality and clarity first, and will reintroduce backgrounds, animations, and textures later.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog[/h2][p][/p][h3]Content[/h3][p][/p][p][b]User Interface[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated all UI elements using the new design system.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the [b]Game menu[/b]: players can now access a summary of known information about others in a dedicated interface. But there’s a catch — opening the Game menu will obstruct your field of view. Make sure you’re safe before using it![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479746/471c92400a00d12658da8e925f039a92c7dac479.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Increased the number of simultaneous announcements from 1 to 4. This should help keep up with action sequences that trigger multiple announcements in quick succession.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479746/efa6446459f05d1f3eb13ca881662d64232155d0.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Added the [b]number of games won[/b] in both the Lobby and Game menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced work-in-progress versions of upcoming menus (Options, Inventory, etc.). These menus are currently empty, but you can already navigate to them.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]input prompts[/b]. The game now supports Keyboard & Mouse and Xbox controllers. Switching controllers automatically updates the visuals of the input prompts.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the localization system, with partial French and Spanish translations.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Fixes[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where NPCs breaking furniture would trigger a camera shake for the host player.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked back-end character management.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked back-end player input handling.[/p][/*][*][p]Added safety checks in the code to prevent potential bugs.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.2.4.0 | Now Available
notes.content:
[h1] Update 0.2.4.0 [/h1]

This minor update introduces a new behavior for the NPC Ruler.

Don’t forget to join the official Discord server for Royal Sauterie 👇

[h2] Changelog [/h2]

[h3] Content [/h3]

[b] NPCs [/b]

[list]
[*] The NPC Ruler can now run away from hostile characters near them.
[/list]

[h3] Balancing [/h3]

[b] Characters [/b]

notes.title: Update 0.2.3.3 | Now Available
notes.content:
[h1] Update 0.2.3.3 [/h1]

This update introduces new UI systems and balancing tweaks to make combat gameplay more engaging.

Don’t forget to join the official Discord server for Royal Sauterie 👇

[url=https://discord.gg/HvprVS8Wy5 style=button]Discord[/url]

Your feedback is invaluable in making Royal Sauterie the best game it can be.

[hr][/hr]

[h2] Changelog [/h2]

[h3] Content [/h3]

[b] UI [/b]

[list]
[*] Added a new UI system to display statuses affecting your character. The UI will display ongoing cooldowns and various states (criminal, disguised, etc.).
[*] The player list UI now indicates if a player is a criminal.
[/list]

[h3] Balancing [/h3]

[b] General [/b]

[list]
[*] Increased dash cooldown from 1s to 3s for all characters.
[*] Increased Dagger attack cooldown from 3s to 5s.
[*] Dropping a weapon now resets the attack cooldown.
[/list]

[b] NPCs [/b]

[list]
[*] Decreased the AI vision radius from 8 to 7 units.
[/list]

[h3] Fixes [/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an audio issue causing the host to hear unwanted SFX triggered by NPCs.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.2.3.2 | Now Available
notes.content:
[h1] Update 0.2.3.2 [/h1]

This update introduces new criminality-related gameplay mechanics and NPC behaviors.

Guards will now pick up weapons and attack criminals!

Don’t forget to join the official Discord server for Royal Sauterie 👇

[url=https://discord.gg/HvprVS8Wy5 style=button]Discord[/url]

Your feedback is invaluable in making Royal Sauterie the best game it can be.

[hr][/hr]

[h2] Changelog [/h2]

[h3] Content [/h3]

[b] General [/b]

[list]
[*] Added a new win condition. The player controlling the Ruler will win the game if the guards kill all heirs.
[/list]

[b] NPCs [/b]

[list]
[*] Added the ability for guards to attack criminals.
[*] NPCs can now detect pickable weapons around them.
[*] Added the ability for guards to interact with pickable weapons.
[/list]

[b] UI [/b]

[list]
[*] Added a new character shadow to identify criminals better. 
[*] Added a new emote to indicate a character blocked incoming damage.
[/list]

[h3] Balancing [/h3]

[b] NPCs [/b]

[list]
[*] Players can no longer kill guards by attacking them. Attacking a guard will knock them out for 5s instead.
[*] Guards dash more precisely. Reduced the time between the dash trigger and the actual dash from 0.4s to 0.3s.
[*] Removed the Disguise from the guards' starting inventory.
[/list]

[b] UI [/b]

[list]
[*] Added a 0.5s delay between emotes to make them more readable.
[/list]

[h3] Fixes [/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect collision detection causing NPCs to get stuck in the environment.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.2.3 | Now Available
notes.content:
[h1] Update 0.2.3 [/h1]

This update introduces the first criminality-related gameplay mechanics and new NPC behaviors.

NPCs will react to players committing criminal actions, starting with guards now chasing and dashing towards criminal players.

Don’t forget to join the official Discord server for Royal Sauterie 👇

[url=https://discord.gg/HvprVS8Wy5 style=button]Discord[/url]

Your feedback is invaluable in making Royal Sauterie the best game it can be!

[hr][/hr]

[h2] Changelog [/h2]

[h3] Content [/h3]

[b] Criminality [/b]

[list]
[*] Knocking out NPCs will turn the attacking player into a criminal.
[*] Added blood splatters.
[/list]

[b] NPCs [/b]

[list]
[*] NPCs can now detect other characters around them. Criminals wearing Disguise will not be detected.
[*] NPCs now have a starting inventory. Guards start the game with a Dagger and a Disguise.
[*] Added the ability for guards to chase criminals. Guards will stop chasing criminals if they cannot see them for 5 seconds.
[*] Added the ability for guards to dash towards criminals.
[/list]

[b] UI [/b]

[list]
[*] Added the inventory UI.
[*] Added a VFX when picking up an item from the ground.
[*] Added a UI announcement when a player becomes a criminal.
[*] Added various emotes to display the state of ingame characters.
[*] Updated the existing announcement UI to improve visual consistency.
[/list]

[h3] Balancing [/h3]

[b] Items [/b]

[list]
[*] Decreased the number of Daggers spawning in chests.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.2.2.0 | Now Available
notes.content:
[h1] Update 0.2.2.0 [/h1]

We're fine-tuning the early game and introducing a new item: the Disguise.

Don’t forget to join the official Discord server for Royal Sauterie 👇

[url=https://discord.gg/HvprVS8Wy5 style=button]Discord[/url]

Your feedback is invaluable in making Royal Sauterie the best game it can be!

[hr][/hr]

[h2] Changelog [/h2]

[h3] Content [/h3]

[b] Level [/b]

[list]
[*] Added 3 rare chests. Rare chests currently only drop the Disguise item.
[*] Added 3 treasure rooms containing rare chests.
[*] Locked doors now have dedicated visuals and only require a single key.
[*]  Added a stone path to the castle's exterior to guide players from their bedrooms to the entrances.
[/list]

[b] Items [/b]

[list]
[*] Added the Disguise. Disguised players will appear as Guards until they either dash, attack, or enter knockback.
[/list]

[h3] Fixes [/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing the game to keep running after quitting.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the players to target the next available interactable object when entering focus.
[/list]

[h2] Known Issues [/h2]

[b] UI [/b]

[list]
[*] Attempting to quit the game from the Main Menu sometimes does not work. Please use Alt+F4 to stop the Royal Sauterie Playtest while we fix this issue.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.2.1.0 | Now Available
notes.content:
[h1] Update 0.2.1.0 [/h1]

Coming out of the previous tests, we felt the game focused too much on action. This update introduces a brand-new castle and should give players more time to explore and plot their next move, especially in the early game.

Don’t forget to join the official Discord server for Royal Sauterie 👇

[url=https://discord.gg/HvprVS8Wy5 style=button]Discord[/url]

Your feedback is invaluable in making Royal Sauterie the best game it can be!

[hr][/hr]

[h2] Changelog [/h2]

[h3] Content [/h3]

[b] Level [/b]

[list]
[*] Added a brand-new castle.
[*] Added doors and chests. Those interactable objects require players to focus for 3 seconds to unlock them.
[*] Added a new item: keys. Some interactable objects, such as doors and chests, may require keys to unlock them.
[*] Added bedrooms. Players now spawn alone in their bedroom with a dedicated painting on the wall.
[/list]

[h3] Balancing [/h3]

[b] Characters [/b]
[list]
[*] Decreased the walking speed of Players from 6 to 5.
[*] Decreased the walking speed of Ghosts from 5 to 4.
[*] Decreased the walking speed of Guards from 4 to 3.
[*] Decreased the walking speed of Rulers (NPC and player-controlled) from 4 to 3.
[/list]

[b] Items [/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked all loot tables in the game.
[/list]

[b] UI [/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the strength of the knockback camera shake.
[/list]

[b] Audio [/b]
[list]
[*] Decreased the volume of the fire SFX from -10 db to -16 db.
[/list]

[h2] Known Issues [/h2]

[b] UI [/b]

[list]
[*] Attempting to quit the game from the Main Menu sometimes does not work. Please use the Task Manager to stop the Royal Sauterie Playtest while we fix this issue.
[*] The target arrow will appear on the next closest interactable object when entering focus. This bug is only visual but may cause confusion about which object is currently in focus.
[/list]
